products.name: NEXBODY Nexbody-X60
products.tagline: Posture, body composition and mobility in one guided system
products.summary: Nexbody-X60 combines 3D depth vision, eight-electrode body composition analysis and guided neck and shoulder mobility assessment in one professional workstation.
features: Automatic anatomical landmark recognition with manual correction
Posture angles, asymmetry indicators, risk levels and posture scoring
Nearly 40 body composition values with reference ranges and segmental analysis
Cervical lateral flexion and arm-elevation assessment
Voice guidance and automatic assessment-position recognition
Email sharing, printing, institution branding and data-interface upload

specs.label: Languages
specs.value: Chinese, English, French, Thai, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish and Ukrainian; additional languages customizable

highlights: Forward head posture, head lateral tilt, uneven and rounded shoulders
Pelvic tilt, knee hyperextension and leg alignment
Weight, muscle, protein, fat, BMI, BMR, WHR and segmental composition

products.name: NEXBODY OneScan
products.summary: OneScan uses a high-density piezoresistive sensor matrix to capture plantar pressure and gait data for clinical assessment, rehabilitation, sports research and teaching.
features: Readable analysis reports for clinical and training workflows
Batch data import and export with open API interface
Optional integration with insole-customization data services
highlights: Stance phase, step timing, cadence and contact metrics

products.name: NEXBODY F20
products.summary: F20 captures the full 3D morphology of both feet in one workflow and combines measurement, arch classification, report comparison and STL model output.
features: More than 30 full-foot measurements including length, width and girth
Hallux valgus and heel valgus angle assessment
Arch-type identification based on AI arch index
STL foot-model download, report comparison and printing
Cloud or local deployment with import, export and interface services

specs.label: Product
specs.value: F20 3D Full Foot Scanner for Both Feet

specs.label: Data workflow
specs.value: Bulk import/export and interface docking supported

highlights: Foot length, width, girth and detailed regional dimensions
Hallux valgus and heel valgus analysis
